comments.text: Closed for this arc as a reduction rather than a deletion. The .1-.5 work is banked in fz-go4-ownership-boundary-audit at a705cec2e. A clean .5 survey run on fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz produced 378 job starts with 32 SealSemanticClosure starts. A prototype SealSemanticClosure deletion without first splitting the whole-root TransportPlan(root)/MaterializedProgram(root) boundary produced 809 job starts and failed backend execution with compiler2_unreachable_control, moving churn into AnalyzeActivation, SeedActivation, DeriveRuntimeDemand, and DeriveTransportPlan. The next deletion attempt needs a precursor that splits the root artifact fan-in into exact per-executable pulls.
